sin.name: plain-journal-text
sin.description: A refusal, a nudge, an option or a command's help is written in the journal's voice: a thing says, names, carries, holds, keeps or picks, or a person is told or given.
sin.rule: Write every text the agent or a person reads in plain words that say literally what happens: the journal shows, a field contains, a reader selects the lines, you are informed or sent.
